name: orchestrator
description: Phase 2 — one epoch of the search loop (PLAN.md §2.1 / IMPLEMENTATION.md §2.1). Runs as a whole agent turn, cron-fired (one epoch per firing). Flow: SAMPLE (command sample-config -> parent_id via UCB) -> READ_IDEA (head the top unclaimed idea from research-ideas.md) -> CLAIM_IDEA (mark it in-progress, file-based) -> FANOUT (spawn K run-experiment lineages; K=1 serial) -> JOIN (wait, empty wait_for = join all) -> LOG (append epoch summary to epoch.log). State lives on disk so a crash just re-fires the cron and resumes. K>1 = parallel lineages (add more spawn blocks). Signalling the idea-secretary is file-based (epoch-signals.log / the [~] mark) since engine bash has no MCP; when run as a real axi agent the secretary reads those files.

read_idea.name: READ_IDEA
read_idea.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
IDEAS="$AR/research-ideas.md"
LINE=$(grep -m1 -E '^- \[ \] ' "$IDEAS" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$LINE" ]; then echo 'idea-default-noop'; else echo "$LINE" | sed -E 's/^- \[ \] *//; s/:.*//'; fi

log.name: LOG_EPOCH
log.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
echo "$(date +%FT%T) epoch parent={{parent_id}} idea={{idea_id}} lineage_cost={{exp_cost_1}}" >> "$AR/epoch.log"
tail -1 "$AR/results.tsv" 2>/dev/null || true
